qualification.education_qualification: PG Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship or GATE. Must have at least 60% marks (or a CGPA of 6.5 on scale of 10).
qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): PG Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) or GATE (b) The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER etc. The candidate must have at least 60% marks (or a CGPA of 6.5 on scale of 10). Desirable Experience: Good knowledge of fundamentals in Plasma Physics, Microwave, Antenna Design & Development. Expertise in Metamaterial antenna modelling and Simulation. Good programming skills in MATLAB/Python/HFSS/CST/ADS. Prior experience of working in the above domains.

selection_process: Candidates possessing the requisite qualification and experience can appear for walk-in interview. The decision of the expert panel set up for interview will be considered final. The appointment is for time bound project and the candidate is required to work dedicatedly for the successful completion of the project. Selected candidate has to join immediately. All the Terms and Conditions for this recruitment will be as per guidelines of DOS/ISRO norms.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this position?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment, so candidates can attend the interview on the specified date. The walk-in interview date is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates need a PG Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per DOS norms.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can appear for a walk-in interview with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at National Institute of Technology Delhi, Delhi - 110036.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring duly filled application form, all original certificates/mark sheets with attested photocopies, and a recent passport size photograph.
